body:
## Overview

Fix Qwen3-Omni's shared BOS/EOS positions with `use_audio_in_video=True`, aligning M-RoPE positions and decode deltas with HF. Follow-up to #58890; related to #58902.

## Claims

- Correct interleaved boundary positions and subsequent text positions; cover one/two videos with/without trailing text.

## Validation

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/model_executor tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_omni_mrope.py tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_omni.py -q
# 18 passed; the four strengthened regression cases fail on main.
pre-commit run --files vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_omni_moe_thinker.py tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_omni_mrope.py
# Passed
```

GPU smoke passed: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, GB200, BF16/TP1/eager, `use_audio_in_video=True`; one 4-frame video with audio generated 64 tokens. This validates execution only; full model-quality evaluation remains pending while this PR is draft.

## Details

No open duplicate found: #58890 fixed span length; this fixes the remaining boundary position values. AI assistance was used; draft pending human review.
